title: Obstructions in Dixon–Rosenfeld and Monstrous Models
content: The Jordan algebras with real diagonal over the biquaternions and the bioctonions that underlie the Dixon--Rosenfeld planes do not exist; over the bioctonions the only Hermitian Jordan algebra is the complex Albert algebra. The derivation algebras of \( \mathbb{C}\otimes\mathbb{H} \), \( \mathbb{C}\otimes\mathbb{O} \) and \( \mathbb{C}\otimes\mathbb{H}\otimes\mathbb{O} \) are \( \mathfrak{sl}(2,\mathbb{C}) \), \( \mathfrak{g}_2^{\mathbb{C}} \) and their sum, twice the stated size, so the Dixon--Rosenfeld planes and lines are not closed under their brackets. The 196560 minimal vectors of the Leech lattice carry the multiplicity-free \( \mathrm{Co}_0 \)-module 1+24+299+2576+17250+80730+95680. This rules out both decompositions stated in Monstrous M-theory, the equivariance of its Griess assignment, and a Leech algebra with these vectors as roots.
